summary: Progyny, Inc. disclosed in an 8-K that its Board approved a share repurchase program of up to $200 million of common stock. The program will be funded from available cash; repurchases may occur in the open market (including Rule 10b5-1 plans) at management's discretion based on stock price and market conditions, and may be suspended or discontinued at any time. No specific price, premium, or timeline was provided. The program does not commit the company to any particular number of shares. Watch for periodic disclosures of repurchase activity under this authorization.
